title: time of sync on xDrip and AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-f dont match
body:

the mode has changed. 
Before smoothing AAPS displayed BG like it was received from BG source
Since smoothing is in place AAPS displays bucked data ie data after recalculation to 5 min like they are used in algorihtm.
Isn't it the reason?
Anyway this issue has a reason of 6 min data.
If it's not your case create another issue with screenshots, logs atc
It has 6 min in my case also, but the main problem is that between 3 bg readings aaps isnt working because of no bg and/or no delta s.
resolve primary issue first. you need 5 min or less
